statement: You are given an integer array nums.
A reverse pair is a pair of indices (i, j) with i < j and nums[i] > 2 × nums[j].
Return the number of reverse pairs.

examples.explanation: The pairs are (1, 4), since 3 > 2 × 1, and (3, 4), since 3 > 2 × 1 again.
Every element is smaller than anything after it, so no element can be more than twice a later one.
Only the final 1 is small enough: 4, 3 and 5 are each greater than 2 × 1, but 2 is not.
